title.description: Short, evocative name for the piece. Not a filename.

description.description: Plain-prose description of what the image contains, 200 to 300 words.

styleGuide.description: Markdown design system with the sections Design principles, Colour, Typography, Layout & grid, Spacing & sizing, Shape borders & elevation, Components, Iconography, Imagery & illustration, Motion, Content & voice, Accessibility, Do and don't. Generic and extrapolated, not a description of one image.

stylePrompt.description: Self-contained instruction block for an AI agent to build in this style in a new project. Never mentions the reference image.

keywords.description: Reusable style and theme terms for briefing other design work.

tags.description: Short kebab-case labels. Reuse existing tags where they fit.
